options.name: access_token
options.description: The access token used to authenticate.

options.name: annotations
options.description: Annotations to allow client tools to store small amount of arbitrary data. This is distinct from labels. https://google.aip.dev/128 An object containing a list of "key": value pairs. Example: { "name": "wrench", "mass": "1.3kg", "count": "3" }. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the annotations present in your configuration.

options.name: auth_kind
options.description: The type of credential used.

options.name: automated_backup_policy
options.description: The automated backup policy for this cluster. AutomatedBackupPolicy is disabled by default.

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: The ID of the alloydb cluster. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: cluster_type
options.description: The type of cluster. If not set, defaults to PRIMARY.

options.name: continuous_backup_config
options.description: The continuous backup config for this cluster. If no policy is provided then the default policy will be used. The default policy takes one backup a day and retains backups for 14 days.

options.name: database_version
options.description: The database engine major version. This is an optional field and it's populated at the Cluster creation time. Note: Changing this field to a higer version results in upgrading the AlloyDB cluster which is an irreversible change.

options.name: dataplex_config
options.description: Configuration for Dataplex integration. This is an optional field. If not set, Dataplex integration will be enabled by default.

options.name: deletion_policy
options.description: Policy to determine if the cluster should be deleted forcefully. Deleting a cluster forcefully, deletes the cluster and all its associated instances within the cluster. Deleting a Secondary cluster with a secondary instance REQUIRES setting deletion_policy = "FORCE" otherwise an error is returned. This is needed as there is no support to delete just the secondary instance, and the only way to delete secondary instance is to delete the associated secondary cluster forcefully which also deletes th

options.name: deletion_protection
options.description: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the cluster. When the field is set to true or unset in Terraform state, a `terraform apply` or `terraform destroy` that would delete the cluster will fail. When the field is set to false, deleting the cluster is allowed.

options.name: display_name
options.description: User-settable and human-readable display name for the Cluster.

options.name: encryption_config
options.description: EncryptionConfig describes the encryption config of a cluster or a backup that is encrypted with a CMEK (customer-managed encryption key).

options.name: env_type
options.description: Specifies which Ansible environment you're running this module within. This should not be set unless you know what you're doing. This only alters the User Agent string for any API requests.

options.name: etag
options.description: For Resource freshness validation (https://google.aip.dev/154).

options.name: initial_user
options.description: Initial user to setup during cluster creation. If unset for new Clusters, a postgres role with null password is created. You will need to create additional users or set the password in order to log in.

options.name: labels
options.description: User-defined labels for the alloydb cluster. **Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.

options.name: location
options.description: The location where the alloydb cluster should reside. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: maintenance_update_policy
options.description: MaintenanceUpdatePolicy defines the policy for system updates.

options.name: network_config
options.description: Metadata related to network configuration.

options.name: project
options.description: The Google Cloud Platform project to use.

options.name: psc_config
options.description: Configuration for Private Service Connect (PSC) for the cluster.

options.name: restore_backup_source
options.description: The source when restoring from a backup. Conflicts with 'restore_continuous_backup_source', 'restore_backupdr_backup_source' and 'restore_backupdr_pitr_source', they can't be set together. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: restore_backupdr_backup_source
options.description: The source when restoring from a backup. Conflicts with 'restore_continuous_backup_source',  'restore_backup_source' and 'restore_backupdr_pitr_source', they can't be set together. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: restore_backupdr_pitr_source
options.description: The BackupDR source used for point in time recovery. Conflicts with 'restore_backupdr_backup_source', 'restore_continuous_backup_source' and 'restore_backupdr_backup_source', they can't be set togeter. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: restore_continuous_backup_source
options.description: The source when restoring via point in time recovery (PITR). Conflicts with 'restore_backup_source', 'restore_backupdr_backup_source' and 'restore_backupdr_pitr_source', they can't be set together. This property is immutable, to change it, you must delete and recreate the resource.

options.name: scopes
options.description: Array of scopes to be used.

options.name: secondary_config
options.description: Configuration of the secondary cluster for Cross Region Replication. This should be set if and only if the cluster is of type SECONDARY.

options.name: service_account_contents
options.description: The contents of a Service Account JSON file, either in a dictionary or as a JSON string that represents it.

options.name: service_account_email
options.description: An optional service account email address if machineaccount is selected and the user does not wish to use the default email.

options.name: service_account_file
options.description: The path of a Service Account JSON file if serviceaccount is selected as type.

options.name: skip_await_major_version_upgrade
options.description: Set to true to skip awaiting on the major version upgrade of the cluster. Possible values: true, false Default value: "true".

options.name: state
options.description: Whether the resource should exist in GCP.

options.name: subscription_type
options.description: The subscrition type of cluster.
